correctness.rationale: For iid atomless observations the probability integral transform gives independent uniforms. Strict conditional stochastic inequalities establish all signs, beta integration gives the complete joint-probability formula, and the sign-positive Hessenberg-minor recurrence proves exact all-n full rank. Every normalization and boundary index is explicit. An independently written exact-rational enumeration script passed 663 assertions, including all permutations through n=7; finite checks support, but do not replace, the general proof.

value.rationale: Opposite-direction lower- and upper-record flag families arise naturally in two-sided sequential extreme screening. The finding gives a complete position-indexed sign classification and the stronger robust sign-nonsingularity phenomenon, answering a natural observability question that aggregate record-count laws cannot resolve. The proof is structural for every n and every atomless iid parent law; it is not a routine variable renaming of any inspected theorem.
